_meta.purpose: Curated developer-doc pages to ingest into the brain as source_system=developer_docs.
_meta.why_curated_not_crawled: A crawler over vendor docs is a politeness and ToS problem and would pull thousands of low-value pages. These are the pages the developer agent is told to ground side-by-side (CAP/UI5/Node) code in — see .claude/agents/developer.md.
deny: community.sap.com — cite-only. developer.md: anti-bot blocks automated fetch. Never add it here.
_meta.note_on_spa_docs: Some vendor docs are single-page apps whose HTML is a JS shell with no prose. webdocs_ingest.py reports those as SHELL rather than storing an empty page — check the run report before trusting a source.
_meta.ui5_comes_from_github_not_the_website: Measured 2026-09-03: ui5.sap.com is an SPA. Its sitemap.xml lists 1000+ URLs but they are all '#/topic/...' fragments — a '#' fragment is never sent to the server, so every one returns the same ~2.1 KB shell. docs/api/api-index.json (1.1 MB) IS fetchable but is an index of class/method NAMES, not usage prose, so it would not catch a bug like 'sortProperty does not sort sap.m.Table'. UI5 therefore comes in via `github_sources` below, from the markdown SAP publishes at github.com/SAP-docs/sapui5. This matters: UI5 is the source that would have caught finding F-17 in SUPPLIER-PO-STATUS-VIEWER-FD-R2.
_meta.why_github_sources_have_no_urls: SAP's doc filenames carry a content hash (glossary-9ef211e.md) that changes whenever a page is republished, so individual paths cannot be curated — they would rot within a release. Each entry names a folder prefix instead and webdocs_ingest.py discovers the current .md paths from the git tree at run time. `match` narrows by filename keyword; `max_files` is a hard cap so an upstream folder reorganisation cannot silently turn a 40-page ingest into a 2,000-page embedding bill.
_meta.github_api_budget: GitHub allows 60 unauthenticated API requests/hour. Each github_sources entry spends exactly ONE (the recursive tree call); every document body is then pulled from raw.githubusercontent.com, which is CDN-served and outside that quota. Keep the number of entries small and this never throttles.
_meta.removed_404s: cap.cloud.sap/docs/guides/using-services, /guides/deployment/to-cf and /guides/deployment all 404 (checked with and without trailing slash). CAP serves no sitemap.xml, so paths must be confirmed by hand before being added here.

github_sources.topic: SAPUI5 — Essentials (data binding, OData models, filtering, sorting)
SAPUI5 — Fiori Elements (annotations, list report, object page)
github_sources._tuning: Measured 2026-09-04 against the live tree: ['annotation','list','object','table','filter','odata'] matched 267 (too broad — 'table' and 'list' hit most of the folder); ['annotation','odata'] matched only 22. The set above targets the middle. 04_Essentials already carries binding/sorting/OData fundamentals, so this entry is deliberately annotation-led — that is the content unique to Fiori Elements.

github_sources._why: The brain had no ABAP style/quality reference. Measured 2026-09-04, ABAP Cloud and RAP queries scored 0.34-0.41 across every hit — uniformly weak, because nothing in the corpus covered developer extensibility. These 142 rule pages carry before/after code examples, which is what makes them useful for grounding generated ABAP rather than just citing a principle.
github_sources._prefix_note: 'docs/rules' has NO trailing slash on purpose: it matches the docs/rules.md index AND all 142 files under docs/rules/, in one entry. Excluding docs/release-notes.md (47 KB of changelog) and the Eclipse-plugin UI pages, which are noise for code grounding.
